lines.text:
Welcome, Master.
I'll be serving you today as a bunny girl.

... I-is there anything you need?
I-It's just... if you stare at me like that...

Hehe, I even received special agent training this time.
I hope I get a chance to show it off to you.
P-perhaps... you prefer bunny girls over maids?

I-it's not so much that I'm embarrassed...
It's just that showing this side of me to you is kind of...

P-please stop staring at me...!
Ahhh...
So embarrassing, so embarrassing, so embarrassing...

Master still says I'm beautiful even when I look like this... 
... Hehe. I really like you, Master.
M-master?! What are you doing here?!

I won't run into Master... right?
It'd be too embarrassing if he saw me dressed like this...
Hehe. Hosting a bunny girl event at the Maid Cafe would be fun.

Are you well, Master?
Hehe. I may be dressed differently than usual, but I'll still do my best to serve you.
I-I did get stronger, but...
I will r-repay you with b-better... s-service...
M-master... Stop...
I n-need to... I need to give something in return...!
Th-th-thank you!
I-I'm really sorry, but could I maybe accept it later...?
You don't hate how I'm dressed... do you...?
Y-you're such a tease, Master. But even so... I'm really happy.
As long as you like it, it doesn't matter how I'm dressed.

Whew... Yeah, I'm okay now.
I'll get it done perfectly.
Yes, Master. I'm listening.
I'll proceed swiftly and silently.
Commencing mission.
I feel a bit self-conscious with Master watching, but...!
I will fight not as a maid, but as an agent!
Watch me, Master... Er... I mean, just for a bit.
I almost made e-eye contact with Master...!
Oh, jeez... I'm getting embarrassed again.
Gotta stay calm, like a true agent...!
I'm ready, Master.
Let me show you the results of my training...!
Everyone, now!
Done and dusted!
It needs to be even more perfect...!
It needs to be more flawless...!
Ah!
Ungh...
Ugh.
It seems... I still lack training...
Mission complete, Master.
